segments.text: Greetings and welcome to this MOOC, Introduction to Biorisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习本慕课“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: This is the second lecture and in this lecture I will be introducing you to the Biorisk Management
segments.zh: 这是第二讲，在这一讲中，我将向大家介绍生物风险管理

segments.text: System.
segments.zh: 体系。

segments.text: The effectiveness and efficiency of a laboratory Biorisk Management System is based on identifying,
segments.zh: 实验室生物风险管理体系的有效性和效率，取决于针对既定目标，识别、

segments.text: understanding and managing a system of interrelated processes for a given objective.
segments.zh: 理解和管理一个由相互关联的过程组成的体系。

segments.text: This will involve defining, structuring and understanding the system as well as continually
segments.zh: 这包括定义、构建和理解该体系，以及通过管理和评估

segments.text: improving the system through management and evaluation as well as establishing resources
segments.zh: 持续改进该体系，并在采取行动之前明确资源

segments.text: constraints prior to action.
segments.zh: 限制。

segments.text: Now as an effective biosafety manager you have to understand that the approach to laboratory
segments.zh: 作为一名称职的生物安全管理者，你必须明白，实验室

segments.text: management involves a knowledge of multiple disciplines.
segments.zh: 管理方法需要多学科的知识。

segments.text: You have to acquire a knowledge of the life sciences, a knowledge of legislation or laws
segments.zh: 你需要掌握生命科学知识，掌握本国与生物安全和生物安保

segments.text: in your respective country pertaining to biosafety and biosecurity as well as some knowledge
segments.zh: 相关的立法或法律知识，以及一定的

segments.text: of engineering.
segments.zh: 工程学知识。

segments.text: You should be able to understand some engineering concepts such as directional air flow and
segments.zh: 你应该能够理解一些工程概念，比如定向气流和

segments.text: air conditioning systems as well as plumbing and other architectural elements.
segments.zh: 空调系统，以及给排水和其他建筑要素。

segments.text: This is something that you need to acquire over the period of your occupation as a biosafety
segments.zh: 这些是你在担任生物安全

segments.text: officer or a Biorisk Manager.
segments.zh: 官员或生物风险管理者的职业生涯中需要逐步掌握的。

segments.text: The learning objectives of this module are to introduce you to the Biorisk Management
segments.zh: 本模块的学习目标是向大家介绍生物风险管理

segments.text: System, the Biorisk Policy, Planning, Implementation and Review.
segments.zh: 体系，以及生物风险方针、策划、实施和评审。

segments.text: These form the essential elements of almost all management practices.
segments.zh: 这些构成了几乎所有管理实践的基本要素。

segments.text: The learning outcomes for this particular module are as follows.
segments.zh: 本模块的学习成果如下。

segments.text: You should be able to describe the Biorisk Management System, develop a policy statement
segments.zh: 你应该能够描述生物风险管理体系，制定界定你所在组织的

segments.text: that defines your organization, develop a plan for the management of your specific objectives,
segments.zh: 方针声明，为管理你的具体目标制定计划，

segments.text: develop a strategy to implement your management system and describe the process of review
segments.zh: 制定实施管理体系的策略，并描述评审

segments.text: and corrective action.
segments.zh: 和纠正措施的过程。

segments.text: Now I understand that not all of you may be employed in a facility that conducts experiments
segments.zh: 我知道，并不是你们每个人都在开展涉及生物因子实验的

segments.text: involving biological agents.
segments.zh: 机构工作。

segments.text: However, for the purpose of this MOOC, I want you to construct a virtual environment
segments.zh: 不过，为了本慕课的学习，我希望你们为自己

segments.text: for you.
segments.zh: 构建一个虚拟的环境。

segments.text: Develop a policy statement for a laboratory management system which you have envisioned.
segments.zh: 为你所设想的实验室管理体系制定一份方针声明。

segments.text: Develop a plan, develop a strategy to implement this plan and describe how you will review
segments.zh: 制定一个计划，制定实施该计划的策略，并描述你将如何评审

segments.text: your implementation and how you will apply corrective action.
segments.zh: 你的实施情况，以及如何采取纠正措施。

segments.text: In Biorisk Management, we adopt what is known as a management systems approach.
segments.zh: 在生物风险管理中，我们采用所谓的管理体系方法。

segments.text: And what exactly is this management system approach?
segments.zh: 那么这种管理体系方法究竟是什么呢？

segments.text: I will delve into this with an example, but for now I will describe some of the elements.
segments.zh: 我会用一个例子来深入讲解，但现在我先介绍其中的一些要素。

segments.text: The first thing that you need to do as a Biorisk Manager is to define your system.
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，你首先要做的是定义你的体系。

segments.text: Once you have defined your system, you can structure that system.
segments.zh: 定义好体系之后，就可以构建这个体系。

segments.text: After you structure it, you can understand the system in terms of interrelated functionalities.
segments.zh: 构建之后，就可以从相互关联的功能方面来理解这个体系。

segments.text: Then you move on to continually improving the system.
segments.zh: 然后进入持续改进体系的阶段。

segments.text: And finally, you establish your resource constraints.
segments.zh: 最后，明确你的资源限制。

segments.text: All Biorisk Management is founded on a policy.
segments.zh: 所有的生物风险管理都以方针为基础。

segments.text: It is essential for an organization to develop a policy statement that caters specifically
segments.zh: 一个组织必须制定专门针对生物风险管理的

segments.text: to Biorisk Management.
segments.zh: 方针声明。

segments.text: For instance, this is an example of a policy in which I have stated a generic word the
segments.zh: 例如，这是一份方针的示例，其中我写了一个通用的词，

segments.text: organization is committed.
segments.zh: 即“组织承诺”。

segments.text: This is an essential word in every policy to its core business.
segments.zh: 这是每份方针中对其核心业务都必不可少的一个词。

segments.text: You can replace this word core business with a specific operation associated with your
segments.zh: 你可以把“核心业务”这个词替换成与你所在组织

segments.text: particular organization.
segments.zh: 相关的具体业务。

segments.text: The next word which I have stated here is continuous improvement.
segments.zh: 我在这里写的下一个词是“持续改进”。

segments.text: This is the element which ensures that your Biorisk Management system is constantly improved
segments.zh: 这一要素确保你的生物风险管理体系在其整个生命周期中

segments.text: upon throughout its life cycle.
segments.zh: 不断得到改进。

segments.text: And finally, I have included a word which is compliance.
segments.zh: 最后，我加入了一个词，就是“合规”。

segments.text: compliance with international and national guidelines and legislation.
segments.zh: 遵守国际和国家的指南及法律法规。

segments.text: This is basically a generic policy.
segments.zh: 这基本上是一份通用的方针。

segments.text: However, you can adopt this policy to your respective organization.
segments.zh: 不过，你可以根据所在组织的情况采用这份方针。

segments.text: This is a very well-known concept in management.
segments.zh: 这是管理学中一个非常著名的概念。

segments.text: The concept of continuous improvement.
segments.zh: 即持续改进的概念。

segments.text: It involves a cyclical process of planning, doing or implementing, checking and acting
segments.zh: 它是一个循环的过程，包括计划、执行或实施、检查和处理，

segments.text: to improve upon the original plan.
segments.zh: 以改进原有的计划。

segments.text: And this leads to a continuous improvement of quality.
segments.zh: 由此实现质量的持续改进。

segments.text: Coming down to an actual example.
segments.zh: 下面来看一个实际的例子。

segments.text: Let us say all of us are involved in an organization and we plan to set up a diagnostic
segments.zh: 假设我们都在一个组织里，计划建立一个用于检测病毒的

segments.text: laboratory for detection of viruses.
segments.zh: 诊断实验室。

segments.text: Let us take this as a real example.
segments.zh: 我们把它当作一个真实的例子。

segments.text: So as a Biorisk Manager, what are the questions which you will pose to your management team?
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，你会向管理团队提出哪些问题呢？

segments.text: The first question is what are the laboratory procedures involved?
segments.zh: 第一个问题是：涉及哪些实验室操作程序？

segments.text: What is the instrumentation required?
segments.zh: 需要哪些仪器设备？

segments.text: And what are the standard operating procedures?
segments.zh: 标准操作规程是什么？

segments.text: The second question is how do we organize the procedures?
segments.zh: 第二个问题是：我们如何组织这些操作程序？

segments.text: Organization of procedures involves planning of the work as well as planning of the allocation
segments.zh: 组织操作程序包括规划工作，以及规划如何

segments.text: of tasks to personnel.
segments.zh: 给人员分配任务。

segments.text: The third question is are multiple procedures involved?
segments.zh: 第三个问题是：是否涉及多个操作程序？

segments.text: Handling of samples derived from patients may involve multiple procedures such as transport,
segments.zh: 处理来自患者的样本可能涉及多个程序，比如运输、

segments.text: decontamination or inactivation.
segments.zh: 去污或灭活。

segments.text: And disposal of waste is another process which may be linked to the operation of your laboratory.
segments.zh: 废物处置是另一个可能与实验室运行相关的过程。

segments.text: The next question we ask is how can I improve the system in terms of safety and efficiency?
segments.zh: 我们要问的下一个问题是：如何在安全和效率方面改进这个体系？

segments.text: Now as a Biorisk Manager, you will note that during the operation of your system,
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，你会注意到，在体系运行过程中，

segments.text: you will encounter what are known as accidents and incidents.
segments.zh: 你会遇到所谓的事故和事件。

segments.text: And accidents and incidents are an indication of some gap in your operational guidelines.
segments.zh: 事故和事件表明你的操作指南存在某些漏洞。

segments.text: These need to be addressed before they can end up as serious incidents or serious accidents.
segments.zh: 这些漏洞必须在演变成严重事件或严重事故之前加以解决。

segments.text: And this forms the basis for continuous quality improvement.
segments.zh: 这就构成了质量持续改进的基础。

segments.text: Finally, the last question which you must address is constraints.
segments.zh: 最后，你必须解决的最后一个问题是限制条件。

segments.text: What are your constraints?
segments.zh: 你有哪些限制条件？

segments.text: Do you have any financial constraints?
segments.zh: 有没有资金方面的限制？

segments.text: Do you have constraints in terms of qualified and competent personnel?
segments.zh: 在合格、胜任的人员方面有没有限制？

segments.text: These are the questions which you must address when you want to commence the planning of
segments.zh: 当你要开始规划任何涉及生物因子的操作程序或业务时，

segments.text: any procedure or operation involving biological agents.
segments.zh: 都必须解决这些问题。

segments.text: Let us look at the same case in point by analyzing the process.
segments.zh: 我们通过分析这个过程来看看同一个例子。

segments.text: So the process of viral diagnosis and detection involves with the sample itself followed by
segments.zh: 病毒诊断和检测的过程从样本本身开始，接着是

segments.text: culture of the sample in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 在实验室中培养样本。

segments.text: This may then involve examination using either microscopy or other techniques such as ELISA
segments.zh: 接下来可能要用显微镜或其他技术进行检查，比如ELISA

segments.text: or PCR.
segments.zh: 或PCR。

segments.text: Finally, the results have to be documented.
segments.zh: 最后，结果必须记录下来。

segments.text: And these results may have to be uploaded to a server or to the client using a secure protocol.
segments.zh: 这些结果可能需要通过安全协议上传到服务器或发送给客户。

segments.text: All of these procedures may result in the generation of waste.
segments.zh: 所有这些操作程序都可能产生废物。

segments.text: And this waste needs to be decontaminated and disposed of in compliance with regulations
segments.zh: 这些废物需要按照法规和标准操作规程

segments.text: and standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 进行去污和处置。

segments.text: Now this is an example of multiple processes in a single organization or even for a single
segments.zh: 这就是一个组织中、甚至单个诊断程序中

segments.text: diagnostic procedure.
segments.zh: 包含多个过程的例子。

segments.text: Now the next layer involves personnel.
segments.zh: 下一个层面涉及人员。

segments.text: Each stage of this process involves personnel.
segments.zh: 这个过程的每个阶段都涉及人员。

segments.text: And these personnel have to be trained to address the risk posed by each of these procedures.
segments.zh: 这些人员必须接受培训，以应对每个操作程序带来的风险。

segments.text: For instance, the personnel handling the sample itself and inactivating the sample may have
segments.zh: 例如，负责处理样本本身和灭活样本的人员可能

segments.text: to be trained in a specific standard operating procedure.
segments.zh: 需要接受特定标准操作规程的培训。

segments.text: So will the person who is culturing the sample and examining the sample.
segments.zh: 负责培养样本和检查样本的人员也是如此。

segments.text: The waste disposal procedures have to be imparted to the personnel involved in the disposal
segments.zh: 废物处置程序必须传授给参与废物

segments.text: of waste.
segments.zh: 处置的人员。

segments.text: This brings us to the step by step process of laboratory management.
segments.zh: 这就引出了实验室管理的分步过程。

segments.text: The first step involves defining the system in which you establish objectives and define
segments.zh: 第一步是定义体系，在这一步中确立目标并定义

segments.text: processes just as we have done in this example.
segments.zh: 过程，就像我们在这个例子中所做的那样。

segments.text: The next step involves structuring the system.
segments.zh: 下一步是构建体系。

segments.text: Structuring the system involves defining the roles and responsibilities of the various
segments.zh: 构建体系包括明确各类人员的角色和职责，

segments.text: personnel and the standard operating procedures which they will adopt in order to ensure
segments.zh: 以及他们为确保遵守标准操作规程

segments.text: compliance with the standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 而要采用的标准操作规程。

segments.text: The third aspect involves understanding the system.
segments.zh: 第三个方面是理解体系。

segments.text: This involves an understanding of the personnel themselves and defining a specific work plan.
segments.zh: 这包括了解人员本身，并制定具体的工作计划。

segments.text: A laboratory manager has to be aware of the limitations of personnel.
segments.zh: 实验室管理者必须清楚人员的局限。

segments.text: Public and continuity of working operations can lead to accidents and the virus manager
segments.zh: 疲劳以及连续不间断的作业可能导致事故，生物风险管理者

segments.text: must ensure that workers are properly trained and not taxed beyond the operational capacity.
segments.zh: 必须确保工作人员接受适当培训，且工作负荷不超出其承受能力。

segments.text: The next step involves the continuous improvement of the system itself.
segments.zh: 下一步是体系本身的持续改进。

segments.text: A virus manager is alert to accidents and incidents.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者对事故和事件保持警觉。

segments.text: He or she addresses these accidents and incidents, identifies gaps and addresses these gaps by
segments.zh: 他或她会处理这些事故和事件，找出漏洞，并通过

segments.text: adopting suitable interventions via standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 标准操作规程采取适当的干预措施来弥补这些漏洞。

segments.text: A good virus manager always establishes resource constraints.
segments.zh: 优秀的生物风险管理者总会明确资源限制。

segments.text: Finding a virus management facility is expensive and involves considerable costs.
segments.zh: 为生物风险管理设施提供资金非常昂贵，涉及相当大的成本。

segments.text: These may be a constraint to its efficient operation.
segments.zh: 这可能会制约其高效运行。

segments.text: Constraints may also come in the form of lack of training and a lack of suitably qualified
segments.zh: 限制也可能表现为缺乏培训，以及缺乏具备相应资质

segments.text: or competent personnel.
segments.zh: 或胜任能力的人员。

segments.text: This brings us to the keys to a successful BRM system.
segments.zh: 这就引出了成功的BRM体系的关键。

segments.text: BRM refers to the Biosrisk Management System.
segments.zh: BRM指的是生物风险管理体系。

segments.text: Let us look at some of the keys.
segments.zh: 我们来看其中的一些关键。

segments.text: At the base of this BRM system is the commitment by top management.
segments.zh: BRM体系的基础是最高管理层的承诺。

segments.text: Top management must assume ownership of the Biosrisk policy.
segments.zh: 最高管理层必须对生物风险方针负责。

segments.text: They must provide adequate resources to ensure that this policy can be implemented.
segments.zh: 他们必须提供充足的资源，确保这一方针能够得到实施。

segments.text: Biosrisk management must be prioritized in every organization.
segments.zh: 每个组织都必须把生物风险管理放在优先位置。

segments.text: Biosrisk policy must be communicated to every member of the organization, including the support
segments.zh: 生物风险方针必须传达给组织的每一位成员，包括后勤

segments.text: staff as well as disposal staff and cleaners.
segments.zh: 人员以及废物处置人员和清洁工。

segments.text: Biosafety and biosecurity management must be integrated throughout the organization.
segments.zh: 生物安全和生物安保管理必须贯穿整个组织。

segments.text: This leads us to the process of air-culturation or developing a culture of conscious Biosrisk
segments.zh: 这就引出了文化培育的过程，也就是在整个组织中培养自觉进行生物风险

segments.text: management across the organization.
segments.zh: 管理的文化。

segments.text: The management should always be alert to identifying opportunities for improvement.
segments.zh: 管理层应始终留意发现改进的机会。

segments.text: And in the case of accidents and incidents, the Biosrisk manager must determine root causes
segments.zh: 对于事故和事件，生物风险管理者必须查明根本原因，

segments.text: and apply the pertinent corrective action.
segments.zh: 并采取相应的纠正措施。

segments.text: The focus of every organization which is involved in the management of the risks associated
segments.zh: 每个参与管理生物因子相关风险的组织，

segments.text: with biological agents should be on continual improvement.
segments.zh: 其重点都应放在持续改进上。

segments.text: This is via ownership, periodic assessment, ensuring effectiveness and efficiency of standard
segments.zh: 具体途径包括：落实责任、定期评估、确保标准

segments.text: operating procedures, promoting preventing actions, focusing on continuous education and training,
segments.zh: 操作规程的有效性和效率、推动预防措施、注重持续教育和培训、

segments.text: setting goals for improvement, recognizing and rewarding employees.
segments.zh: 设定改进目标，以及认可和奖励员工。

segments.text: Let us move on now to the planning phase.
segments.zh: 下面我们进入策划阶段。

segments.text: Planning involves risk assessment, hazard identification and risk management.
segments.zh: 策划包括风险评估、危害识别和风险管理。

segments.text: This constitutes the basis of the AMP cycle which is based on risk assessment, risk mitigation
segments.zh: 这构成了AMP循环的基础，AMP循环基于风险评估、风险缓解

segments.text: and performance assessment.
segments.zh: 和绩效评估。

segments.text: I have discussed this cycle in the first lecture of this MOOC.
segments.zh: 我在本慕课的第一讲中讨论过这个循环。

segments.text: Another aspect which is involved in planning is conformity and compliance.
segments.zh: 策划涉及的另一个方面是符合性与合规性。

segments.text: You must identify all relevant requirements and fulfill them within the scope of the
segments.zh: 你必须识别所有相关要求，并在生物风险管理体系的

segments.text: Biosrisk management system.
segments.zh: 范围内满足这些要求。

segments.text: There may be specific legal requirements which are dependent on your national, federal,
segments.zh: 可能存在具体的法律要求，这取决于你所在国家、联邦、

segments.text: state, regional or regulatory authorities.
segments.zh: 州、地区或监管部门。

segments.text: Ensure that your organization complies with these requirements.
segments.zh: 要确保你的组织遵守这些要求。

segments.text: Planning also involves setting objectives, targets and programs.
segments.zh: 策划还包括设定目标、指标和方案。

segments.text: One needs to establish, maintain and document virus controls objectives and targets.
segments.zh: 需要建立、保持并记录生物风险控制目标和指标。

segments.text: Documentation is essential in any laboratory as it ensures traceability.
segments.zh: 文件记录在任何实验室中都必不可少，因为它能确保可追溯性。

segments.text: One needs to establish controls and establish procedures for the documentation of the controls
segments.zh: 需要建立控制措施，并建立控制措施的文件记录程序，

segments.text: in order to ensure the effective application to the risk management cycle.
segments.zh: 以确保在风险管理循环中有效应用。

segments.text: Let us move on to implementation and operation.
segments.zh: 下面来看实施与运行。

segments.text: The first stage of a Biosrisk management system involves planning.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理体系的第一阶段是策划。

segments.text: And to that, we implement this plan and operationalize it.
segments.zh: 在此之后，我们实施这个计划并将其付诸运行。

segments.text: Implementation and operation involves the establishment of the organizational structure,
segments.zh: 实施与运行包括建立组织架构，

segments.text: the allocation of roles and responsibilities to every member of the organization, the
segments.zh: 为组织的每位成员分配角色和职责，

segments.text: appointment of qualified and competent personnel, the implementation of training as a component
segments.zh: 任命合格且胜任的人员，作为质量持续改进的组成部分

segments.text: of continuous quality improvement and communication of the Biosrisk management policies and practices
segments.zh: 开展培训，以及把生物风险管理方针和做法传达到

segments.text: across the organization.
segments.zh: 整个组织。

segments.text: This is a brief description of the organizational structure.
segments.zh: 这是对组织架构的简要说明。

segments.text: At the top of this hierarchy, one notes the top management.
segments.zh: 在这一层级结构的顶端是最高管理层。

segments.text: Top management defines the overall policy.
segments.zh: 最高管理层确定总体方针。

segments.text: Then we have senior management which reports to top management and the Biosrisk management
segments.zh: 然后是向最高管理层汇报的高级管理层，以及生物风险管理

segments.text: committee which refers to or reports to the senior management.
segments.zh: 委员会，它向高级管理层汇报。

segments.text: At the base of this organization are the advisors.
segments.zh: 这个组织的基层是顾问。

segments.text: The organization may have to call in special advisors to address specific requirements in
segments.zh: 组织可能需要聘请专门的顾问来满足

segments.text: terms of biosafety and biosecurity.
segments.zh: 生物安全和生物安保方面的特定要求。

segments.text: The Biosrisk manager or the biosafety officer is a critical component of this hierarchy.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者或生物安全官员是这一层级结构中的关键组成部分。

segments.text: Then we have the facility manager.
segments.zh: 然后是设施经理。

segments.text: The facility manager is an engineer who oversees the management of the facility.
segments.zh: 设施经理是负责监督设施管理的工程师。

segments.text: He or she will ensure the operation of the electrical, mechanical, heating, ventilation and
segments.zh: 他或她会确保电气、机械、供暖、通风和

segments.text: air conditioning systems.
segments.zh: 空调系统的正常运行。

segments.text: The occupational health and safety personnel are involved in ensuring that the personnel
segments.zh: 职业健康与安全人员负责确保工作人员

segments.text: comply with the OS and H guidelines.
segments.zh: 遵守职业安全与健康指南。

segments.text: Security management involves both physical security as well as data security.
segments.zh: 安保管理既包括实体安保，也包括数据安全。

segments.text: And finally, some facilities which are involved in managing animals and animal studies may
segments.zh: 最后，一些管理动物和开展动物研究的设施可能

segments.text: have separate personnel to manage animals and their containment facilities.
segments.zh: 会有专门的人员来管理动物及其防护设施。

segments.text: This is an overview of the structure of the organization.
segments.zh: 这是组织架构的概览。

segments.text: We now move on to operational management.
segments.zh: 接下来我们来看运行管理。

segments.text: Once you have defined the roles and responsibilities of all the personnel involved in the safe working
segments.zh: 在明确了参与设施安全运行的所有人员的角色和职责之后，

segments.text: operation of your facility, you have to define the different operations which occur concurrently
segments.zh: 你必须明确在设施内

segments.text: in the facility itself.
segments.zh: 同时进行的各项不同业务。

segments.text: And this involves operational control.
segments.zh: 这就涉及运行控制。

segments.text: In addition to biosafety, laboratories have to comply with procedures involving electrical,
segments.zh: 除生物安全外，实验室还必须遵守有关电气、

segments.text: chemical and physical safety.
segments.zh: 化学和物理安全的程序。

segments.text: Inventory management is another aspect which is very relevant to documentation of procedures.
segments.zh: 库存管理是另一个与操作程序文件记录密切相关的方面。

segments.text: Work planning must be conducted in order to ensure that work is distributed evenly and
segments.zh: 必须进行工作规划，以确保工作分配均衡，

segments.text: personnel are not taxed beyond their operational limits.
segments.zh: 人员的工作负荷不超出其承受极限。

segments.text: Personal practices need to be put in place which define the scope and responsibilities
segments.zh: 需要建立人员管理规范，明确组织中

segments.text: of every member of the organization.
segments.zh: 每位成员的工作范围和职责。

segments.text: Operational management also involves waste management for the safe disposal of waste
segments.zh: 运行管理还包括废物管理，以安全处置设施

segments.text: generated by a facility.
segments.zh: 产生的废物。

segments.text: Personnel management focuses on the training of personnel in terms of their knowledge,
segments.zh: 人员管理侧重于对人员进行培训，提高他们在生物风险管理方面的知识、

segments.text: skills and abilities pertaining to biorisk management.
segments.zh: 技能和能力。

segments.text: And finally, infrastructure and operational management focuses on the maintenance of the
segments.zh: 最后，基础设施与运行管理侧重于设施本身的维护，

segments.text: facility itself and involves both preventive maintenance as well as maintenance following
segments.zh: 包括预防性维护以及故障

segments.text: breakdowns.
segments.zh: 后的维修。

segments.text: As you can see, the effective management of any facility involves multiple operations.
segments.zh: 可以看到，任何设施的有效管理都涉及多项业务。

segments.text: These operations will occur concurrently and integrating all these operations is a skill
segments.zh: 这些业务会同时进行，而把所有这些业务整合起来是

segments.text: that must be acquired by a biorisk manager.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者必须掌握的一项技能。

segments.text: Finally, we move on to review.
segments.zh: 最后，我们来看评审。

segments.text: The top management must review the organization's biorisk management system and the review must
segments.zh: 最高管理层必须对组织的生物风险管理体系进行评审，而且评审必须

segments.text: be done periodically.
segments.zh: 定期进行。

segments.text: The top management must decide on the periodicity of the review.
segments.zh: 最高管理层必须决定评审的周期。

segments.text: This may be in the form of an annual review, a weekly review or a monthly review.
segments.zh: 可以是年度评审、每周评审或月度评审。

segments.text: The primary reason for this review is to evaluate suitability, adequacy and effectiveness
segments.zh: 评审的主要目的是评价风险缓解措施的适宜性、充分性和有效性，

segments.text: of the risk mitigation measures and to assess opportunities for improvement as part of the
segments.zh: 并按照质量持续改进的理念

segments.text: philosophy of continuous quality improvement.
segments.zh: 评估改进的机会。

segments.text: This is some of the information which may be required during a review.
segments.zh: 以下是评审期间可能需要的一些信息。

segments.text: One is to look at the results of the audits, evidence of compliance to standard operating
segments.zh: 一是审核结果、遵守标准操作

segments.text: procedures, status of risk assessment activities, status of preventive and corrective action,
segments.zh: 规程的证据、风险评估活动的状况、预防和纠正措施的状况、

segments.text: follow up actions from previous management reviews, recommendations for improvement, accident
segments.zh: 以往管理评审的后续行动、改进建议，以及事故

segments.text: and incident investigation.
segments.zh: 和事件调查。

segments.text: Please take note that documentation at every stage of the operation is critical to an
segments.zh: 请注意，运行每个阶段的文件记录对于

segments.text: effective and efficient review.
segments.zh: 有效、高效的评审至关重要。

segments.text: This brings us to the end of this lecture.
segments.zh: 本讲到此结束。

segments.text: In this lecture, I have provided you with an overview of the following.
segments.zh: 在这一讲中，我向大家概述了以下内容。

segments.text: Firstly, we have looked at the management systems approach to biorisk management.
segments.zh: 首先，我们了解了生物风险管理的管理体系方法。

segments.text: Then we have looked at the key elements of a successful biorisk management system.
segments.zh: 然后我们了解了成功的生物风险管理体系的关键要素。

segments.text: We have learned how to develop a biorisk management plan, ensure conformity and compliance
segments.zh: 我们学习了如何制定生物风险管理计划，确保符合并遵守

segments.text: with existing national regulations, implement the biorisk management system and the process
segments.zh: 现行国家法规，实施生物风险管理体系，以及

segments.text: of review of the system.
segments.zh: 体系的评审过程。

segments.text: Now in your own specific country, I want you to identify documents related to biosafety
segments.zh: 现在，我希望大家找出你们本国与生物安全

segments.text: and biosecurity.
segments.zh: 和生物安保相关的文件。

segments.text: These can be in the form of laws, guidelines, acts or legislation.
segments.zh: 这些文件可以是法律、指南、法令或法规。

segments.text: Please refer to these documents as they will be critical to development of effective laboratory
segments.zh: 请参阅这些文件，因为它们对于建立有效的实验室

segments.text: management system.
segments.zh: 管理体系至关重要。

segments.text: These are some of the references.
segments.zh: 这些是一些参考资料。

segments.text: I have included these references as PDF documents along with this lecture.
segments.zh: 我已将这些参考资料以PDF文件的形式附在本讲中。

segments.text: Thank you for your participation in this lecture.
segments.zh: 感谢大家参与本讲的学习。

segments.text: I look forward to interacting with you in the next lecture.
segments.zh: 期待在下一讲中与大家交流。

segments.text: Thank you and stay bio safe.
segments.zh: 谢谢，请注意生物安全。
